cause_quote: The introducing diff gates the chat queue on `props.placementStartup?.initialTurn`, while the status returned before the runtime loads has no `initialTurn`.
user_saw: The first prompt was missing from chat while startup loaded, and opening an already-provisioning session showed progress beneath the composer.
summary: The fix displays the first prompt before the cloud startup runtime loads and moves worker setup progress into the conversation.
reasoning: The parent had lazy cloud startup and showed the first message after sending started. PR #131594 introduced pending prompts in chat, but its diff supplies the first turn only from the loaded runtime, so the gap was present from the start. I also checked PR #135024, which separately introduced the composer status for provisioning sessions without an active startup entry.
